value.name: walks witness through questioning order
value.description: Asha guides the agency witness through the sequence of topics she intends to cover, starting with the employment timeline and moving through the drop-ins and pickup window.
evidence: walked her through the order she meant to take the agency witness in—employment timeline first, then the Wednesday and Friday drop-ins, then the question about the school-pickup window

value.name: withholds Tuesday report contradiction
value.description: Asha keeps the Tuesday report face-down and deliberately avoids naming the conflicting line from Devin's corrected filing.
evidence: She kept the Tuesday report face-down under her left palm and did not name the line in Devin's corrected filing that now ran against it
that was a decision for the room, not for this table

value.name: deletes sent message
value.description: Across town, Rosa deletes the two-word message she had sent earlier and leaves her phone face-down on the counter.
evidence: Across town, in the kitchen where she had drunk two cups of coffee while Asha was still in Whitfield's office, Rosa picked up her phone, opened the thread, and deleted the two words she had sent at six-forty, then set the device face-down on the counter and left it there

value.name: acknowledges exhibit with coffee cup
value.description: Mrs. Hatcher nods through the pages and lifts an untouched coffee, while Asha lets the cup's sound hang in the room before continuing.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher nodded at each page in turn and finally lifted the coffee she had not touched
Asha let the small sound of the cup against the saucer sit between them before she moved to the next exhibit

value.name: steadies herself for next exhibit
value.description: Asha keeps her hands steady on the folder as she moves on, despite the morning's strain.
evidence: her hands steady on the folder in a way her morning had not earned

value.name: files report away in folder
value.description: Asha moves the Tuesday report to the bottom of the folder and closes it, choosing to keep the decision off the table.
evidence: Asha lifted her left palm from the Tuesday report, slid it face-down to the bottom of the folder, and closed the cover with a small sharp click that landed in the quiet of the conference room
Asha let the decision sit where she had put it, inside the folder rather than on the table between them

value.name: reacts to folder closing
value.description: Mrs. Hatcher looks up at the sharp click of the folder closing, then returns her attention to the coffee cup.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher looked up at the sound, then back at the coffee cup in her hands

value.name: washes hands after deleting message
value.description: Rosa stands at the counter, runs cold water, and washes her hands slowly after deleting the message.
evidence: Across town, Rosa stood from the counter where her phone still lay face-down, ran the tap until the water was cold, and washed her hands without hurrying
